description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff development within a supportive environment. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in overseeing daily nursing operations and ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence.

This position comes with a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000. We are particularly interested in candidates who are Registered Nurses (RNs) and possess a strong background in skilled nursing or long-term care. If you are a compassionate leader ready to make a difference, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with some leadership or supervisory experience
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking a dedicated Part-time Dietary Cook to join the team at a premier health and wellness center. In this vital role, you will be responsible for preparing delicious and nutritious meals that meet the dietary needs and preferences of our residents, ensuring a high standard of culinary service and resident satisfaction. You will play a key part in creating a positive dining experience for those in our care.The ideal candidate will have a passion for cooking and a commitment to food safety and quality. This part-time opportunity offers a chance to contribute to a supportive environment focused on the well-being of our residents.
requirements: Proven experience in food preparation, preferably in a healthcare or institutional setting
Knowledge of food safety and sanitation regulations
Ability to follow menus and dietary restrictions accurately
Strong organizational and time management skills
